definition: to eat your evening meal at a restaurant
description: A smiling young man in a navy suit stands at a candlelit table at a canal-side restaurant at night, on a wooden deck under glowing string lights, with tall brick houses and a bridge behind. He takes a plate covered with a silver dome from a cook in a white jacket in a rowing boat on the water, carries it to the table and sits down holding it, while a cloud of steam rises from under the dome. His companion, a young woman, laughs at the table, and other couples dine at white-clothed tables along the deck.

en.question: What is the young man carrying?

de.answer: Er trägt das Abendessen zum Tisch.
de.question: Was trägt der junge Mann?

es.answer: Está llevando la cena a la mesa.
es.question: ¿Qué está llevando el joven?

fr.answer: Il porte le dîner jusqu'à la table.
fr.question: Que porte le jeune homme ?
